title: mRNA sequencing of 28 visceral leishmaniasis-HIV patients in NW-Ethiopia (pre-post treatment)
description: Study looked at changes in gene expression levels in blood after 29 days of treatment with AmBisome or AmBisome/miltefosine to identify blood-based signatures to discriminate treatment outcome.
